8.2.2 Dcm_ConfigType
[SWS_Dcm_00982] Definition of datatype Dcm_ConfigType ⌈
Name
Dcm_ConfigType
Kind
Structure
Implementation specific
Type
–
Elements
Comment
–
Description
This type defines a data structure for the post build parameters of the DCM . At initialization the
DCM gets a pointer to a structure of this type to get access to its configuration data, which is
necessary for initialization.
Available via
Dcm.h
